name: Miss Each Other
source:
Main character decides to enter different universities after graduation with his female friend Misa. He brings a camera to make a photo of Misa to cherish in future, but camera gets confiscated by the teacher. When two young people are left together to prepare graduation photo collection, Misa unexpectedly reveals a secret...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角與女性友人美沙決定畢業後升入不同的大學。他帶來相機，想替美沙拍一張照片留作日後的紀念，相機卻被老師沒收。當兩名年輕人被單獨留下製作畢業紀念冊時，美沙意外揭露了一個秘密……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
